responsibility: This file implements the MIPS target’s native CPU detection hook used by the GCC driver when expanding %:local_cpu_detect for -march=native and -mtune=native. It inspects the host system’s /proc/cpuinfo, recognizes a small set of Linux-exposed MIPS processor model strings such as Loongson, SB1, R5000, and Octeon variants, and returns the corresponding replacement command-line option string, making it the driver-side bridge between the host machine description and MIPS processor-selection options.
